blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) rejects calls for a “shoot-to-kill” approach in serving an arrest warrant against Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, amid the circulation of fabricated quote cards attributing such a call to a lawmaker. “The PNP does not subscribe to a shoot-to-kill approach. Our mandate is to enforce the law, not to take the law into our own hands,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Tuesday. The statement came after Cagayan de Oro 1st District Rep. Lordan Suan denied social media claims that he had called for a “shoot-to-kill” resolution against Dela Rosa. READ: Legislator […]...
